sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Wilderness State Park resources via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/maps)

values.note: DNR rate table: Lakeshore East/West and Pines $45 a night with 20/30-amp, $50 with 50-amp, $40 at the semi-modern rate (when the modern restrooms are closed); Full Hook-up loop $60. Recreation Passport required for entry.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Wilderness rows: Full Hook-up $60; Pines Campground and Lakeshore Campground - East and West $50 / $45 / semi-modern $45 / $40), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/wilderness (East Lakeshore: 13 sites with 50-amp; West Lakeshore: 19 sites also offering 50-amp) + DNR rate table (Full Hook-up: 'Sites include water, electric, & sewer') + midnrreservations.com resources (18 Full Hook-up sites: 50 amp, water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Booking site: East Lakeshore 65 (two of them walk-in tent sites), West Lakeshore 71, Pines 99 and Full Hook-up 18, besides 25 walk-in tent sites, backcountry sites and cabins. No site is a pull-through. Listed site lengths mostly 40-60 ft (Full Hook-up 60-90 ft).

sites.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Wilderness State Park campsite resources by map, 'Pull Through' and 'Site Length' attributes) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/wilderness (Number of sites: 65, 99, 71), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Modern toilet and shower buildings open mid-May to mid-October; East Lakeshore also has dishwashing.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/wilderness (each modern campground: toilet & shower building, sanitation station) + DNR rate table ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station, water spigots for fresh/potable water and electrical'), read 2026-10-20

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/wilderness ('For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed fees $40-$60 and season (recorded today). Added 50-amp electric with water and sewer in the Full Hook-up loop, 253 campsites with no pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/potable water/sanitation station, reservable. Not stated on the park's pages: booking window, min/max stay, fcfs, max rig length (one 96-ft listing looks unreliable).
